versions.content: If the parameter job - >jobPrimitive Info - >primitiveInfo - >service is set to CRYPTO_KEYSETVALID, CRYPTO_RANDOMSEED, CRYPTO_KEYGENERATE, CRYPTO_KEYDERIVE, CRYPTO_KEYEXCHANGECALCPUBVAL or CRYPTO_KEYEXCHANGECALCSECRET, the parameter job - >cryptoKeyId must be in range; else the function Crypto_Proc essJob shall report CRYPTO_E_PARAM_HANDLE to DET and return E_NOT_OK.
